title: Classic WCS POLYLINE non-default extrusion loss guard
scope: Prevent typed DXF output from silently dropping a non-default extrusion vector on a classic WCS POLYLINE family record, while retaining the valid default normal and existing WCS vertex coordinates.

implementation.behavior: writePolyline refuses a non-default extPoint for 3D POLYLINE, polygon-mesh, and polyface-mesh flags before opening the record transaction. The default (0,0,1) remains admitted; tolerant read behavior is unchanged.
implementation.why: The writer emits WCS vertices and intentionally omits DXF extrusion groups for these flags. Refusing a non-default retained vector avoids silently claiming lossless output without a qualified projection.

formatEvidence.observation: Autodesk describes POLYLINE group 30 as WCS elevation for a 3D polyline and lists group 210 as an optional extrusion direction.
formatEvidence.implementationInference: The reference does not define a semantic effect for a non-default group-210 vector on a WCS 3D polyline. Because this writer omits that retained field, fail closed until its behavior is qualified.

assertions: non-default extrusion refusal preserves an existing destination sentinel
the caller's extrusion and WCS vertex values remain unchanged on refusal
correcting to the default normal retries successfully on the same adapter
typed readback preserves both 3D vertex coordinates
raw output omits extrusion groups 210/220/230 for WCS vertices
control.fixturePolicy: The control authors its model in test code and writes only to a temporary path; no DWG/DXF fixture was added.

limitations: No physical producer or native consumer semantics are established.
This guard does not establish general 3D POLYLINE, polygon mesh, or polyface support.
